coverageNotes: Tests absence of automatic referential actions and whole-mutation rollback. Does not measure implementing the full indexed cascade or multi-hop graph discovery.

questions.concept: ID validators do not create automatic cascades
questions.question: What is committed?

options.text: The user and both documents are deleted because authorId is an ID reference.
options.rationale: An ID validator does not implement cascading deletes. The parent-only execution preserves both documents.

options.text: The mutation fails because two documents still reference the user.
options.rationale: ID validation checks the table identity, not live referential integrity. The deletion succeeds with dependent rows present.

options.text: The user is deleted and both documents keep their existing authorId values.
options.rationale: Only the explicit user delete occurs. Dependent documents and their ID values persist unchanged.

options.text: The user is deleted and authorId is removed from both documents.
options.rationale: Convex does not perform an implicit set-null or field-removal referential action.
